thread:
alex: Quick smoke — spun up lattice-512-int6 on staging. Initial recall@10 down ~6% vs baseline float32. anyone free to triage? :eyes:

maria: Can you paste the eval config and top-level numbers?

alex: Eval run (holdout-5k, k=[1,5,10], cosine)
```
model: lattice-512-int6
recall@1: 0.342
recall@5: 0.612
recall@10: 0.688
baseline (float32): recall@10: 0.735
silhouette: 0.21 (baseline 0.27)
notes: per-tensor quant, symmetric, 6-bit
```

ben: Hmm, silhouette drop + recall down — sounds like quant noise. Were per-channel scales tried?

alex: Not yet. This was quick per-tensor run to get baseline numbers.

ingrid: Also check batchsize during embedding; we saw microbatching change embed distribution earlier. What batch size used at infer?

alex: Inference batch=64 (staging default). Offline eval used batch=32. I can re-run with 16/64 to check.

sam: Can you share nearest-neighbor UMAP? I want to eyeball anchor drift.

alex: link: https://internal-plots/redwood/embeds/lattice-512-int6/umap (preview)

maria: Also run paraphrase holdout (synth) — if semantic grouping breaks, we'll see compaction loss.

alex: Re-ran quick ablation: per-channel int6 vs per-tensor int6 vs float32
```
float32 recall@10: 0.735
int6 per-tensor recall@10: 0.688
int6 per-channel recall@10: 0.721
```

ben: Per-channel looks much better — suggests calibration/scaling was the culprit. Any KNN ID flips in top1?

alex: top1 idflip rate (vs float32) per-tensor: 9.8% | per-channel: 3.1%

ingrid: Silhouette per-channel: 0.25 — closer to baseline. Good sign.

maria: OK plan: 1) prefer per-channel quant for this model 2) run full holdout sweep (10k) 3) sanity-check short-query recall@1/5/10 and cluster NMI 4) document rollback/fallback policy if regressions >4% recall@10

alex: I'll run the 10k sweep overnight, include batch-size parity and eval seeds. tagging @eval-bot to run automated comparison.

eval-bot: scheduled job 1761119500: embed-holdout-sweep (model=lattice-512-int6, variants=[per-tensor,per-channel], dataset=holdout-10k)

sam: Nice. If per-channel passes, we should add quant config to model manifest and a canary rollout with fallback to float32.

alex: Agreed. I'll add manifest PR and a small canary rule (5% traffic) if staging metrics look good.

maria: Thanks team — keep notes in the PR and ping if anything odd. :thumbsup:
